Term Insurance vs Endowment Plan: Which Is Better? (2026)

Term insurance provides pure life cover at low cost. Endowment plans combine insurance with savings. We compare both.

HK
Hari Kotian
| 2026-02-15T12:00:00.000Z | 1 min read

Choosing between term insurance and endowment plans is one of the most important financial decisions you will make.

Term Insurance:

  • Lowest premiums (Rs.1Cr cover for Rs.800-1,500/month)
  • High coverage, easy to understand
  • No maturity benefit - pure risk cover

Endowment Plan:

  • Combines insurance with savings
  • 5-10x higher premiums for same cover
  • Returns: 4-6% per year
  • Guaranteed maturity benefit

Comparison:

| Feature | Term Insurance | Endowment | |---|---|---|---| | Premium (Rs.1Cr) | Rs.12,000-18,000/yr | Rs.80,000-1,50,000/yr | | Death Benefit | Rs.1 crore | Rs.1 crore + bonus | | Maturity | Nil | Sum assured + bonus |

The Verdict: Buy TERM insurance for life cover + invest the difference in MUTUAL FUNDS. This gives higher coverage AND better returns.

Need help choosing? Contact Insurance Support to compare plans.
